record.description: Paper I's layered geometric/textual observations used to motivate projection dependence and naming; an interpretive image-derived corpus. The later tomography program imposes stronger inverse-problem tests.
record.note: Two rotated families of cosine waves define a useful synthetic interference field. The formula is a probe construction, with scale, direction vectors and phase conventions to be specified. Its reference to M-22 points to a three-probe comparison rather than an exact source for the field equation.
